input: Reach out to three industry contacts for informational chats

gold.taskTitle: Reach Out to Three Industry Contacts for Chats
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to contact three people in their industry to set up informal informational conversations.

questions.title: What specific industry or field are these contacts in?
questions.description: Identify the industry or professional domain the contacts belong to.

questions.title: Do you already have three contacts in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has identified specific people or needs help deciding who to reach out to.

questions.title: What is the main topic you want to discuss?
questions.description: Clarify the purpose or subject matter of the informational chats.

questions.title: What is your deadline for making all three contacts?
questions.description: Establish a timeframe or target date for completing the outreach.

questions.title: Which channel will you use to reach out?
questions.description: Identify the preferred communication method such as email, LinkedIn, phone, or another platform.

questions.title: What is your current relationship with these contacts?
questions.description: Determine whether these are warm connections, cold contacts, or mutual introductions.

questions.title: What outcome do you want from these conversations?
questions.description: Clarify what success looks like, such as job leads, advice, collaboration, or general networking.
